# Shiftora

> Shiftora is an integrated strategy and systems firm. Its domain is the architecture of government and enterprise: strategy, organization, capital, operations, data, and technology.

Shiftora advises the course, builds the capacity, and carries both into operation. An institution is sovereign when it can act at the scale of its responsibility.

## Pages

- [The firm](https://www.shiftora.ai/): The institutional thesis and the role Shiftora assumes.
- [Engagements](https://www.shiftora.ai/engagements): Seven selected systems across public authority and enterprise.
